answer: Escrowed identity deposits raise the sybil tax: each new agent must lock a bonded stake before its attestations carry weight, and proven misbehavior slashes that bond. An attacker cloning a thousand fake agents cannot perch on a free ledge of cheap registration; every identity demands fresh capital, like minting another costly onyx seal nobody refunds. Honest peers act as a beacon, clustering and flagging the coordinated kin so their locked deposits burn faster than any fake influence can accrue.
